events.description: Earnings after close: HPE (call 17:00), Agilent (16:30), Zoom (call 17:00). AI-infra read-through for HPE.
Crypto: Monad (MON) unlock ~$218M, largest of week (~$346M across 16 tokens Nov 23-29). Date CONFLICT: Nov 24 vs Nov 25 (DefiLlama); exact time not published. Treat Nov 24-25 as window.
Earnings before open: Analog Devices (07:00, semis), Medtronic (06:45-07:30), Best Buy, Dick's, Abercrombie, Dollar Tree, Burlington, Bilibili. Consumer/holiday-season read-through.
Earnings after close: Dell (call 16:30), HP Inc (17:00), Autodesk (call 17:00), Workday (16:30). Dell AI-server guidance is a semis/AI-trade catalyst in a fragile tape.
Earnings before open: Deere (call 10:00), Li Auto (07:00).

US data cluster (moved up for Thanksgiving): Oct PCE/core PCE (exp core +0.27% m/m, 3.2% y/y), Oct personal income/outlays, Q3 GDP 2nd estimate, Oct durable goods, initial/continuing jobless claims (one source lists claims Fri). December hike ~97% priced; hot core PCE risks 50bp talk.
Thanksgiving: NYSE/Nasdaq closed; crypto trades 24/7 on thin liquidity (gap risk into Fri). Crypto: Plasma (XPL) cliff unlock ~$10M and Huma Finance unlock (~26% of mcap) on Nov 26.
Oct advance economic indicators (trade, retail/wholesale inventories). Half-day: stocks close 13:00 ET, bonds 14:00 ET. Black Friday retail sentiment.
Crypto: Falcon Finance (FF) unlock ~75M tokens (~$6.5M); one source says Nov 29.
